Subject: Approval request: logo & quote rights in exchange for extended discount

Hi Monica / Laura —

Quick context: Volt Systems (large prospect in energy mgmt) is asking for a 25% list discount on a 12-month committed Dedicated plan. They’ve made a conditional ask: Redwood can use their logo, a short quote from their VP Product, and co-publish a joint case study + customer quote on our site and in PR materials. They specifically want the right to review the quote and request minor edits, and they want a short embargo window before public distribution.

Why I’m escalating: the deal desk cap is 15% without exec sign-off and marketing/legal want a signed release before we create a case study. Volt is near close; revenue and reference potential are high and they’re pushing for the 25% concession tied to publicity rights.

Recommendation: Approve the 25% discount conditioned on: 1) a 6-week review/embargo window for any joint PR, 2) a limited non-exclusive logo & quote release (no transferable rights), 3) marketing gets a signed release (attached stub) that includes Redwood review of technical claims only. Attachments: pricing_summary_VS_deal-4682.pdf, Volt_case_study_template_v1.docx (draft).

Requested action: Monica / Markus — can we get an expedited sign-off today so legal can finalize release and I can confirm terms with Volt? Laura, can marketing commit to the co-auth process and fast turnaround?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: rachel.kim@voltsys.com (Rachel Kim, VP Product, Volt Systems)

Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request: logo & quote rights in exchange for extended discount

Sean — thanks for the clear summary. Volt is happy to provide a logo, a short quote from me, and participate in a joint case study. A few asks from our side:

- We’d like the quote and case study draft provided at least 7 business days before any public release for review.
- We will not agree to any unlimited attribution or transfer rights (our legal team will redline to ensure non-transferable).
- We expect the 25% discount to apply for the first 12 months from go-live; after that standard renewal terms.

If Redwood can confirm those points and provide the release template, Volt legal will expedite review. We’re motivated to move quickly — we see Redwood as strategic for our upcoming grid orchestration pilot.

Best,
Rachel

VP Product, Volt Systems

Sean / Laura —

Thanks for the heads-up. Legal concerns / redlines to expect:
- Replace any language that could be read as assignment/transfer. We can approve a non-exclusive, non-transferable logo & quote release.
- Add a carve-out that Redwood will not publish technical claims about Volt’s products without explicit approval.
- Limit embargo/review to 7 business days (Volt requested 7; I think that’s reasonable).
- Sign-off authority: Volt legal will need to sign the release. Our standard release + minor edits should suffice; I’ll push back only on open-ended indemnities.

Commercial: I can sign off on the 25% discount conditional on marketing acceptance of the joint timeline and sales ops capturing it in the SOW (discount line item + term). We still need Markus (VP) to OK the extra discount percentage vs. the deal desk band.

I’m attaching a redline stub of the release (signed_release_stub.pdf) to use in negotiation.

-Monica

Subject: Re: Approval request: logo & quote rights in exchange for extended discount

Thanks team — I reviewed the ask and the commercial impact. Given Volt’s strategic fit and reference value, I’m prepared to approve a one-time 25% list discount for the first 12 months under the following conditions:

1) Marketing and Product Marketing (Laura) confirm they will manage the case study and meet the 7-business-day review window; marketing owns final scheduling.
2) Legal (Monica) to limit the release to non-transferable logo & quote rights; Redwood cannot make technical claims about Volt without explicit wording approval.
3) Sales to capture the discount as a discrete line item in the SOW with a clear 12-month term and renewal back to list thereafter.
4) This approval requires a signed release before publishing and a final DocuSign link archived under the deal record.

Assuming the above, Sean — you have my approval. Please proceed and get signed docs in place before any public mention.

-Markus

Team / Volt —

Summary and next steps following Markus’ sign-off:

- Commercial: 25% discount applied to Dedicated plan for first 12 months from go-live. Sales to add a discrete discount line in SOW and tag in HubSpot (DEAL-2026-4682).
- Publicity: Redwood granted non-exclusive, non-transferable rights to use Volt Systems logo and a short quote from Rachel Kim. Redwood will provide a joint case study draft; Volt has 7 business days to request edits.
- Embargo: 7 business day review window; if no response the draft is approved.
- Claims: Redwood will not publish technical claims about Volt’s products without Volt’s explicit approval.
- Signatures: Volt legal and Redwood counsel will exchange signed release via DocuSign; attach the signed_release_stub.pdf as a start.

Action owners:
- Sean: finalize and send the release + SOW amendment to Volt; include pricing_summary_VS_deal-4682.pdf.
- Laura: own case study process and schedule; confirm readiness within 48 hours.
- Monica: finalize the release language for DocuSign; I’ll upload the final to the deal record.

Volt legal (cc) — please confirm you’ll sign the redline or propose final edits by Mon, 23 Feb so we can publish before your pilot launch.

Thanks — approval granted once signatures are in place.

Monica Patel
